trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no online trophy and no DLC trophy on the list, so one single-player playthrough is enough.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies on this list; the platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops. [1][5]
Work the roadmap in order (stages S1–S7): story first, then character questlines, robberies, activities, and the 100% checklist last. [1][3]
Keep cheats off for the whole run: every guide agrees cheats switch off trophies and saving. [1][4][7]

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The first story trophy. It pops when the opening mission ends, so it cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and see it through to the end. [1][2]
The trophy unlocks automatically at the mission's end; no side objective is needed. [1][3]

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the one thing in the chapter that can disappear.

steps.text: Play through all of Chapter 1's main missions until the chapter closes. [1][2]

Before finishing the chapter, do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude): after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. [1][2]
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1: there is no mission replay, so a chapter-start save is your only way back. [1][3]

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Character switching unlocks during this chapter, and the optional bowling robbery for Let's Go Bowling appears here — do it while it is marked.

steps.text: Play through all of Chapter 2's main missions, starting with What's in the Bag?, until the chapter closes. [1][2]
After the mission Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia and call the other in as a partner. [1][2]
While in Chapter 2, take the optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling when it appears (see Let's Go Bowling): it is the earliest window for that trophy's three valuables. [1][2]

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. This is the chapter where the Key Cloner, the Snap Gun, and several character questlines unlock — take the optional missions as they appear.

steps.text: Play through all of Chapter 3's main missions, starting with Welcome to Vice City, until the chapter closes. [1][2]
Take optional missions as they appear: the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS unlocks the Key Cloner, and Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies. [1][2]
Character questlines that start here (Andy, Randy, Tyrone) stay available after the story, so there is no rush to finish them inside the chapter. [1][2]

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The optional mission That's Where The Money Is… appears near the end of this chapter — it unlocks bank vault robberies and two trophies, so do not skip it.

steps.text: Play through all of Chapter 4's main missions until the chapter closes. [1][2]
Near the end of the chapter, take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… when it is marked: it teaches bank vault robberies and feeds Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play. [1][2]
Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter; with no mission replay it is your only backup. [1][3]

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.disagree: Sources differ on wording: the official description says only 'Complete the final mission', while Beebom and CULTR word it as Chapter 5 (EGamers). PowerPyx lists the final mission under Chapter 5 as well. Both versions agree it is the last story mission.
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the story. It pops when the final mission ends; keep a manual save from just before it, because after the credits the game continues in free-roam.

steps.text: Play the final story mission to the end. [1][2]
Make a manual save just before the final mission: the game has no mission replay and no New Game+, so this save is your only way to replay the ending. [1][3]
After the credits you return to free-roam and the 100% Completion checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. [1][2]

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run to the end. [1][2]
The trophy pops during the mission; after it, character switching between Jason and Lucia unlocks. [1][2]

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist to the end. [1][2]
The trophy pops during the mission; no side objective is needed. [1][3]

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play to the end. [1][2]
The trophy pops during the mission; no side objective is needed. [1][3]

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners to the end. [1][2]
The trophy pops during the mission; no side objective is needed. [1][3]

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown to the end. [1][2]
The trophy pops during the mission; no side objective is needed. [1][3]

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory to the end. [1][2]
The trophy pops during the mission; no side objective is needed. [1][3]

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the last one most players earn. The checklist is lenient — roughly 60% of true completion — and everything on it stays available after the story.

steps.text: Finish the story first: the 100% Completion checklist only appears after the credits, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. [1][2]

Work the checklist in this order: robberies (all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations), then underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races, Bret's 15 Target Decks, and any 70 of the 80 challenges. [1][2]
Use the lenient counts: scan any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, study any 100 of the 255 animals, complete 15 of the 18 card sets, 15 of the 18 meditations, and 300 of the 397 stunts. [1][4]
Do any 100 optional missions for the checklist: there are far more than 100 in the game, so missed timed ones never block you. [1][2]
Nothing on the checklist is missable; every item can be finished in free-roam after the story. [1][6]

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. The fastest category is flying under bridges, and the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

steps.text: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts, mixing the four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, and 25 base jumps. [1][2]
Prioritise under-bridge flights: every guide calls them the quickest kind to clear. [1][4]
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name and mark. [1][2]
Keep going to 300 stunts afterwards: the 100% checklist needs 300, so this trophy is a milestone on the way to A Long Road. [1][4]

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once. Most unlock naturally through the story and map exploration, so this usually pops on its own.

steps.text: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see the 9 types and how many of each you have done. [1][2]
Do one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. [1][2]
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find the nearest unplayed type. [1][2]

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 range locations. The golds are not very hard, and they also feed your Focus level.

steps.text: Visit the 12 shooting range locations and play every challenge at each one until you hold gold in all 42. [1][2]
There are two ranges holding the 42 gold medals between them; gold every challenge at one range before moving to the next so none is missed. [2][4]
Shooting ranges also raise your Focus level, which makes Gunslinger easier later. [1][2]

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 races in total across them). One win per location is enough.

steps.text: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations across Leonida. [1][2]
Win at least one race at each location; the 42 races across the locations all count toward the 100% checklist too. [1][4]
Drone races count as a race type for Master of None, so this also ticks one of the 9 activity types. [1][2]

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, and the 100% checklist wants 30 wins, so this is a milestone on the way.

steps.text: Win races at 20 different locations out of the 40 unique race locations. [1][2]
Vary the race type: car races, race challenges, and Top Fun drone races all count as race wins. [1][6]
Keep going to 30 wins afterwards: the 100% checklist needs 30 unique race wins. [4][6]

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Follow Cal's fishing questline after you meet him in Chapter 1, then beat him in a fishing challenge when he texts you.

steps.text: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui. [1][2]
After that mission, wait for Cal's text message: it marks a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. [1][2]
Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge he sets. [1][2]
Fishing also feeds your Focus meter: each fish landed adds about 10% to Focus. [2][1]

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade games. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1.

steps.text: Pick any of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. [1][2]
Play the first three at the TV in your home by interacting with the controllers; Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. [1][2]
Finish every level of the chosen game at least once: you do not need to beat all of its challenges, just reach the end. [1][2]

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's Lucia-only questline in Chapter 3. All five quests stay available after the story.

steps.text: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3: Andy calls you, then texts her home address, marking the questline on the map in Belville. [1][2]
Complete all 5 Andy quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. [1][2]
The final quest, Puff Puff Pass, ends the line and pops the trophy; every quest stays available after the story. [1][2]

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It starts in Chapter 1, pauses while Kenton is unavailable, and resumes later — nothing in it can be missed.

steps.text: Work for Kenton in the Chapter 1 main mission Island Dreams; a while later he calls you and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. [1][2]
Dive the shipwrecks he marks with purple treasure-chest icons, dig up the treasure with the metal detector, and bring it back to his shop. [1][2]
After each set he calls you back and marks more locations; clear all 7 shipwrecks in total for the questline. [1][2]
If Kenton goes quiet, keep playing: he becomes available again in Chapter 2–3 (playing as Jason he texts you), or call Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 to speed it up. [1][2]

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's five-quest line at the Thrillbilly Mud Club. It starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and stays available after the story.

steps.text: After the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, Billy's line is marked at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. [1][2]
Complete all 5 Billy quests in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. [1][2]
The final quest, Hometown Heroes, ends the line and pops the trophy; every quest stays available after the story. [1][2]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count — the character questlines with their own trophies (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy) do not.

steps.text: Find Strangers & Freaks side quests in the open world; they stay available after the story in free-roam. [1][2]
Complete strands that count, for example Kirk's Skunk Ape line, Kyle's McKittrick Farm line, Yago's street-racing line, and Pilot Pete's delivery line. [1][2]
Do not count Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, or Billy lines toward this trophy: the game does not count them as strangers. [1][2]
Watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list after each strand: it shows how many of the 8 you have completed. [1][2]

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver the 16 sports cars he wants. The list unlocks in Chapter 3 and can be completed entirely after the story.

steps.text: In the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, steal the Zorrusso for Randy: this unlocks the Key Cloner and starts Randy's Wish List. [1][2]
Open Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List to see the 16 sports cars he wants; he marks some in fixed locations and more as you deliver. [1][2]
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then steal it and drive it back to Randy's garage in west Vice City. [1][2]
Deliver cars in good condition for more money; sports cars are common around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. [1][2]

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's Jason-only questline: destroy the synthetic labs, then shut them down for good. It starts in Chapter 3 and stays available after the story.

steps.text: After the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, play as Jason: purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear in Vice City. [1][2]
Go to the labs and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. [1][2]
After destroying enough labs, Tyrone gives the second quest Spin On This: shut the labs down to end the line and pop the trophy. [1][2]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.disagree: Sources differ on the count: the trophy needs all 18 meditation spots (PowerPyx, GTABase), while the 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18 (EGamers). Both numbers are shown here; the trophy count is 18.
trophies.guide: The only possibly missable trophy in the game. Meditate at all 18 spots — and do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia before Chapter 1 ends, because it disappears and may be required.

steps.text: Chapter 1, do this FIRST: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow her and choose Accept. [1][2]

That balcony meditation adds +1 to the counter in the Progress menu but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it — PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy, so do it to be safe. [1][2]
Meditate at the other 18 spots across 10 locations: spots show as purple icons when you are close, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2. [1][2]
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; the final spot needs both characters playable, which unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. [1][2]
Note the count gap: the trophy needs 18 spots, but the 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18, so the checklist alone does not finish this trophy. [4][1]

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: WATCH — the trigger is still unconfirmed: no source has pinned down which animal unlocks this trophy. Follow Bret's Jason-only hunting line and finish his target decks; the trophy should pop along the way.

steps.text: Play as Jason after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: Bret Vogel texts you and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. [1][2]
Meet Bret, then hunt the animals he requests at the purple icons he marks; bring each animal back to him as Jason. [1][2]
Use the hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 Bret gives you (retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation): one clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine and pays more. [1][2]

WATCH: PowerPyx and EGamers both say it is still unconfirmed which animal exactly unlocks this trophy, so finish all 15 Target Decks (also needed for 100%) and the trophy should pop on the way. [1][4]

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this silver is a milestone on the way.

steps.text: Find collectible cards around Leonida and complete any 3 full sets out of the 18 sets in the game. [1][2]
Keep collecting after the trophy: the 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets. [1][4]
Track sets under Progress > Collections; each completed set counts toward both this trophy and the checklist. [1][2]

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app. Any 100 count — landmarks, curiosities, and sculptures are the easiest to find.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app on the phone (hold Up to use it instantly) and scan objects in the environment by holding Up then R1. [1][2]
Scan any 100 locations: there are more than 100, including 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, and 23 sculptures, so it does not matter which 100 you pick. [1][2]
The 100% checklist also needs 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and the checklist finish together. [4][1]

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Most finish on their own while you work on other trophies; pick the easiest ones left at the end.

steps.text: Open Progress > Challenges to see all 80 challenges and which are done; a checkmark in the bottom right marks each completed one. [1][2]
Complete any 50: many finish naturally while you work on other trophies and the 100% checklist. [1][2]
Save this for late in the run, then pick the easiest and quickest of your remaining challenges; the checklist needs 70 of 80, so you will pass 50 on the way. [1][4]

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach 4 stars with your partner beside you, then escape the red heat zone. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia — or just rob bank vaults, which give 4 stars automatically.

steps.text: Unlock partner play after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, then call your partner with hold Right + Triangle. [1][2]
Cause carnage with your partner beside you until you reach a 4-star wanted level. [1][2]
Escape on a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic to leave the search area; if a helicopter chases you, shoot it down. [1][2]

The trophy pops only after you leave the red heat zone, not the flashing search area: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) is the easiest escape, since cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. [1][4]
Or let it happen on its own: bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so you will likely earn this while working on Maximum Withdrawal. [1][2]

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. Never let the wanted level drop between shops — and wait half a minute after the third shop, the pop is delayed.

steps.text: Unlock partner play after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, then call your partner with hold Right + Triangle. [1][2]
Rob a first shop to gain a wanted level, then loot a second and a third shop in a row while the police are still chasing you. [1][2]
Keep the red/blue flashing wanted level alive the whole chain: if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. [2][1]
The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so wait before hitting a fourth; if it still has not popped, rob a fourth shop and keep going. [2][1]
Good spot: the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; rob a couple of items in each and break the safe in the back room. [1][2]

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app. You only need to scan them, never drive them — stand on a busy road and scan the traffic.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up to use it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it; scanning counts as discovering it. [1][2]
Stand on a busy road and scan every passing vehicle; the game has 557 vehicles at launch across cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, and planes. [1][2]
Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles, which shows found counts per category. [1][2]
Keep scanning to 200 base models afterwards: the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models. [1][4]

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies inside one Combat Focus. Fill Focus first, eat or use Adrenaline to stretch it, and pick a group of gang enemies — soldiers, police, and civilians do not count.

steps.text: Fill your Focus bar first: eat and drink, wash your face or shower at home, and carry Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend Combat Focus. [1][2]
Find a group of 5 gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal gang operation, and get close wearing body armor from Ammu-Nation. [1][2]
Aim a firearm and press L3 + R3 to trigger Combat Focus, which slows time and highlights weak spots, then drop all 5 enemies in that one use with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. [1][2]
Note what does not count: the trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police, or civilians — only gang enemies. [1][4]
It gets easier as Focus levels up: raise Focus by playing shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, and landing headshots. [1][2]

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA — gates E3/E4 are the easiest — and fly about 1 km away. The pop is delayed, so keep flying.

steps.text: Go to Vice City International Airport (VCIA) and find a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge; planes parked on the open airfield do not count. [1][2]
Use the plane at gates E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and climb the stairs next to the boarding bridge, whose door leads straight inside. [1][2]
Go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backward toward the runway, take off, and fly away from the airport. [1][2]
Keep flying until you are about 1 km from the airport: the trophy is delayed and only pops at that distance. [1][4]
Save first: the police come fast once you are on the airfield. [2][1]

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station on Goose Key and fire on enemies from inside it until the trophy pops.

steps.text: Go to Mile Zero Air Station on Goose Key, at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. [1][2]
Find the tanks parked on the south side of the air base; drive through the gate or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance to get in. [1][2]
Climb into a Rhino tank, then drive and fire at enemies until the trophy pops. [1][4]

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun, slip in a jewelry store's back door silently, find the safe code, empty the safe, and leave unseen.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. [1][2]
Go to a jewelry store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it: kicking the door in sets off the alarm, the Snap Gun does not. [1][2]
Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, destroy the security footage, and disable the alarm. [1][2]
Leave without being seen: the trophy pops shortly after you leave the store. [1][2]
Good target: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. If anyone spots you, reload and try again. [2][1]

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: DO EARLY — the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks bank vaults. Rob any 5 of the 8 vaults and escape; the 100% checklist needs all 8.

steps.text: DO EARLY: finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (it is marked automatically from story progress). Tail a security van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open. [1][2]
Bring your partner: you cannot carry all the cash alone, so hold Right to hand off one bag. [1][2]

After the mission, pay Yasmani for tips about security vans ($10,000 each; he needs his earlier Payday Loans jobs done first): the vans are marked with a purple icon, so follow them to the next bank. [1][2]

Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape each time: every vault robbery gives a 4-star wanted level instantly, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognisable. [1][2]
Each vault pays up to $205,000, and the checklist needs all 8, so this trophy finishes on the way to A Long Road. [1][4]

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: DO EARLY — robbing a bank vault in That's Where The Money Is… counts as robbing an armored truck, so this pops in the same mission. You can also blow open a roaming armored truck earlier.

steps.text: DO EARLY: play the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail the armored truck to the bank, enter the vault while it is open, and escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). [1][2]
Robbing the vault counts as robbing the armored truck, so the trophy pops in that same mission. [1][2]

Earlier method: block a roaming armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. [1][2]

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map of Leonida. A plane is the fastest way: fly over every black fog patch until all 52 areas are visible.

steps.text: Take a plane and fly over every part of the map still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. [1][4]
Work region by region so no fog patch is missed; the map clears area by area as you fly over it. [1][5]
Unfogging also marks activities, strangers, and collectibles on the map, which feeds Master of None and the other exploration trophies. [1][2]

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this pops on the way.

steps.text: Find illegal gang operations: they are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. [1][2]
Rob one operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. [1][2]
Track progress under Progress > Gangs: scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed in the bottom right. [1][2]
Keep going to all 39 operations afterwards: the 100% checklist needs every one. [1][4]

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.disagree: Sources disagree: EGamers (18 Nov) listed this trophy's steps as unconfirmed, while PowerPyx (read 20 Nov) gives the concrete steps below (Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Apple Martini). Both versions are shown; the PowerPyx steps are the newer report.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it standing next to the bar. EGamers had this unconfirmed on 18 Nov; PowerPyx's newer steps are shown here.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach. [1][4]
Buy an Apple Martini at the bar. [1][4]
Drink it while standing next to the bar to unlock the trophy. [1][4]

Sources disagree note: EGamers (18 Nov) had these steps unconfirmed; PowerPyx (20 Nov) reports the bar and the drink above. If the bar does not trigger it, check back — launch-era details are still being confirmed. [4][1]

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.disagree: Sources disagree: EGamers (18 Nov) listed this trophy's steps as unconfirmed, while PowerPyx (read 20 Nov) gives the concrete steps below (blue Banshee, Key Cloner, south Vice City showroom). Both versions are shown; the PowerPyx steps are the newer report.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first. EGamers had this unconfirmed on 18 Nov; PowerPyx's newer steps are shown here.

steps.text: First unlock the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (steal the Zorrusso for Randy). [1][2]
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and find the blue Banshee inside. [1][4]
Hack into the Banshee with the Key Cloner, then drive forward straight through the showroom window. [1][4]
Keep driving away down the street: the pop is slightly delayed. Only this blue Banshee counts, not any other car. [1][4]
Sources disagree note: EGamers (18 Nov) had these steps unconfirmed; PowerPyx (20 Nov) reports the Banshee and the showroom above. [4][1]

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: DO EARLY — in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, then escape the police.

steps.text: DO EARLY: take the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling when it is marked automatically; it leads to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation. [1][2]
Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first: you need them to blow open the safe. [1][2]

Inside the alley, steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it open with sticky bombs). [1][2]
Escape the police after the third item: the trophy pops after the escape, not when you pick the item up. [1][2]
Not missable: if you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can return for the remaining valuables. [1][2]

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time. Always train together — while one works out, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles.

steps.text: Unlock partner play after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, then call your partner with hold Right + Triangle before every workout. [1][2]
Buy a membership at a fitness club and work out there; filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities (dumbbell icon). [1][2]
Always train with both characters together: while you actively work out with one, the other completes their training automatically. [1][2]
Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Strength (heart icon); the trophy pops once both are at maximum at the same time. [1][4]
You can also work out at home after the story if any Strength is left to build. [1][2]

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. It fills passively through robberies and fights, so it usually pops on its own late in the run.

steps.text: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action changes your profile. [1][2]
Do 500 profile actions in total; click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. [1][4]

Every robbery and enemy encounter counts: finishing objectives stealthily and destroying evidence leans Professional, incapacitating without killing leans Hardened, killing leans Violent, and mass killing leans Psycho. [1][2]
Avoid the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent once reached, and police become far more aggressive toward you. [1][4]
Single-source note: the 500-action figure comes from one source (GTABase, via EGamers); treat the number as reported, not confirmed in-game. [4][1]

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: WATCH — the trigger is still unconfirmed. The only lead is the Payday Loans store from the prologue: the name suggests succeeding on a second attempt there. Do the lead, keep a save, and check back as launch-era reports come in.

steps.text: WATCH: no source has confirmed this trophy's trigger yet. PowerPyx marks it 'currently unknown (believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from Prologue)'. [1][4]
Lead to try first: return to a Payday Loans store and attempt the same job a second time — the description 'Second time's the charm' points at succeeding on a retry. [1][4]
Make a manual save before trying the lead, so you can retry cleanly if the first attempt fails. [1][3]
This trophy is NOT flagged missable by any source: nothing suggests its window can close, so leave it for cleanup and re-check the sources panel as new reports land. [4][1]

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.disagree: Sources disagree: EGamers (18 Nov) listed this trophy's steps as unconfirmed, while PowerPyx (read 20 Nov) gives the concrete UFO steps below (road north-west of Starlet Motel, night after 2AM, solo). Both versions are shown; the PowerPyx steps are the newer report.
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg: at night after 2AM, go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, find the blinking car, and follow the path into the woods.

steps.text: Go solo at night, after 2AM, to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. [1][4]
Look for a blinking car at the roadside: if it is not there, drive away and come back — the spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed. [1][4]
Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and approach the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). [1][4]
The UFO drops a woman it abducted: talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy. [1][4]
Sources disagree note: EGamers (18 Nov) had these steps unconfirmed; PowerPyx (20 Nov) reports the UFO event above. [4][1]

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.disagree: Sources disagree: EGamers (18 Nov) listed this trophy's steps as unconfirmed, while PowerPyx (read 20 Nov) gives the motorcycle-kick method below (10 pedestrians in 60 seconds). Both versions are shown; the PowerPyx method is the newer report and is still single-source.
trophies.guide: WATCH — the trigger is still single-source. The lead: ride a motorcycle or push bike and kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds in a crowded area.

steps.text: Take any motorcycle or push bike to a crowded area such as Vice City or Ocean Beach. [1][4]
Ride past pedestrians and kick them with Square: the lead says 10 kicks within 60 seconds. [1][4]
WATCH: EGamers (18 Nov) had these steps unconfirmed and PowerPyx (20 Nov) is the only source reporting the kick method, so treat it as a lead, not a confirmed trigger. [4][1]

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through fences. Unlock the Dye Pack Jammer first, then bring marked bills from bank and Payday Loans jobs to a fence — Yasmani pays the most.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew): it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. [1][2]
Rob banks and Payday Loans stores to collect marked bills. [1][2]
Bring the marked bills to a fence: Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 total is cumulative across all robberies — you do not need to carry it at once. [1][2]
Bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 per robbery, so this finishes naturally while you do the 8 vaults for the 100% checklist. [1][4]

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, cumulatively. Guns, car mods, and tattoos are the fastest way to burn through it.

steps.text: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across every kind of shop; the total counts across all shops, not one. [1][2]
Buy the expensive things first: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos are the fastest way to reach $100,000. [1][2]
Normal spending during the run already feeds this total, so check it late and top it up with one big purchase if needed. [1][2]

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages in the Vice City Real Estate app for about $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses): garages become buyable and the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone. [1][2]
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the phone app; together they cost about $160,000. [1][2]
Do not count the 4 story-related garages: only the 8 purchasable ones matter for this trophy. [1][4]
Fund it with robberies: later Chapters 3–4 robberies pay far more than early ones. [1][2]

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 stolen vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Buy garages first — each registered car needs a free garage space — and use cheap cars to keep the cost down.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses): the Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone. [1][2]
Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes): every registered vehicle needs a free garage space. [1][2]
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then in his garage choose Respray and Register. [1][2]
From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray; registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes. [1][2]
Register 10 vehicles in total to pop the trophy. [1][2]
